text.text:
Quarterly Maintenance Notice
We will upgrade the document archive on Saturday, 21 November, between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
During this window the search page and file downloads will be unavailable.
All existing records will be kept. After the upgrade, please sign in again and review your saved settings. If
anything looks wrong, contact the help desk at extension 4512.
What changes
Search results load about twice as fast, scanned pages can be rotated in the viewer, and exported
reports now include page numbers.
